notes: I1 met: own gravimetric (Hiden IGA-001) H2 uptake at 77 K, 0-1 and 0-20 bar, buoyancy-corrected (SI p. 4-5). I2 is the deciding criterion and is a judgement call: the monomer-derived formula C66H18S6 (main, p. 2) is roughly 79 wt% carbon, and the authors call the product 'graphenal', but the samples are low-temperature (40 C) FeCl3-coupled organic polymer networks (conjugated microporous polymers, partly chlorinated per the IR band at ~700 cm-1, main p. 2), never carbonized; the Raman D/G bands (Fig. S4) do not make them a carbonized material. Protocol 3 excludes uncarbonized polymers, so I2 is not met and the code is not_carbon. I3 to I5 would be met. Not retracted (record.json is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the text). Primary research article, not a review. No statement that the H2 values were published before.
